newsitem.title: USA: Entergy Waterford unit restart delayed.
newsitem.headline: Entergy Waterford unit restart delayed.

text.p: Entergy Corp said on Wednesday that a fault in one of two startup transformers will delay restart of its Waterford 3 nuclear station after its eighth refueling outage, scheduled to be completed the middle of next week.

Although planned refueling and maintenance activities have been successfully completed at the plant, technical specifications require that both startup transformers be operable when the plant goes back on line, Entergy said.
An internal fault was discovered during routine testing recently, Entergy said.
Entergy said that a replacement transformer at Waterford has been located and that it is preparing the station to install the replacement.
Waterford officials estimate a mid-July startup date, Entergy said.
The fault of the startup transformer had no impact on any of the plant's safety-related systems and will not impact service reliability to customers, the company said.
